purpose: Discover the revised JRC-ESTAT 100 m population exposure proxy without conflating modelled cells with observed census or insured exposure.

entries.name: JRC-ESTAT Census Population Grid 2021, 100 m, revision 2026.07
entries.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre / Eurostat
entries.spatial_scope: Europe; exact country and raster extent require original asset inspection
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 100 m modelled resident population count per cell; 1 km census V2-0 of 2024-06-16 disaggregated using residential built-up volume
entries.note: Publisher identifies DOI 10.2905/JRC.VP18KXG and revision 2026.07 with updated LUISA residential areas. Uses Census V2-0, not V3 of May 2026; no independent V3 CSV-TIFF parity or independent building-footprint validation. Shared EUBUCCO, Overture, GHSL and TomTom inputs require lineage and third-party rights review. Fine-scale counts are estimated, not enumerated residents, insured locations, TIV or exact dwellings. Catalogue links a ZIP and declares anonymous access and EU reuse subject to attribution and third-party rights. Original ZIP member inventory, byte identity, CRS, NoData, units and aggregate conservation remain unverified.
